loveCompat.title: Love Compatibility Calculator
loveCompat.subtitle: Zodiac Compatibility
loveCompat.description: Discover how your zodiac signs connect in love. Select both signs to reveal your emotional, romantic, and long-term compatibility.
loveCompat.intro: Zodiac compatibility examines the astrological relationship between two signs based on their elemental nature, modality, and position in the zodiac wheel. While Sun sign compatibility is just one layer of a complex astrological picture, it provides meaningful insight into the fundamental dynamics of a relationship.
loveCompat.howP1: Zodiac compatibility is based on the angular relationship (aspect) between two signs in the zodiac wheel. Signs that are 120° apart (trine) share the same element and naturally harmonize. Signs that are 60° apart (sextile) have complementary elements. Signs that are 90° apart (square) create dynamic tension that can fuel growth. Opposite signs (180°) are magnetically attracted through their complementary qualities.
loveCompat.howP2: This calculator evaluates the fundamental sign-to-sign relationship. For a more detailed analysis considering Moon, Venus, Mars, and other planetary placements, try our advanced birth chart compatibility tool.
loveCompat.pairsNote: All 78 sign combinations available — search any two signs above.
loveCompat.faq1q: How accurate is zodiac sign compatibility?
loveCompat.faq1a: Sun sign compatibility provides a broad overview of relationship dynamics. For a more nuanced picture, a full synastry chart comparing Moon, Venus, Mars, and other planetary placements is recommended.
loveCompat.faq2q: Can incompatible signs have a good relationship?
loveCompat.faq2a: Absolutely. Sun sign compatibility is just one factor. Many thriving relationships exist between signs that are traditionally considered challenging. Personal growth, communication, and effort matter more than any astrological factor.
loveCompat.faq3q: What makes two zodiac signs compatible?
loveCompat.faq3a: Signs of the same element (Fire, Earth, Air, Water) naturally understand each other. Complementary elements (Fire-Air, Earth-Water) also tend to harmonize well. The angular aspect between signs in the zodiac wheel determines the type of energy in the connection.
loveCompat.faq4q: Should I avoid dating incompatible signs?
loveCompat.faq4a: No. Astrology offers insight and self-awareness, not rigid rules. Every sign combination has strengths and growth areas. What matters most is how both people communicate, respect each other, and grow together.

venus.title: Venus Sign Calculator
venus.subtitle: Love & Attraction
venus.description: Venus governs how you love, what attracts you, and how you express affection. Discover your Venus sign and understand your romantic nature.
venus.intro: In astrology, Venus represents love, beauty, pleasure, and attraction. Your Venus sign reveals your romantic style, what you find beautiful, and how you connect with others on an emotional and physical level. It is one of the most important placements for understanding your love life.
venus.noTimeWarning: Venus sign calculated without birth time. Venus changes signs approximately every 3–4 weeks, so this result is likely accurate. For exact degree, provide your birth time.
venus.howP1: Venus orbits the Sun in approximately 225 days, spending about 3–4 weeks in each zodiac sign. Its position at the time of your birth determines your Venus sign. Because Venus is never more than 47° from the Sun, your Venus sign is always the same as, or within two signs of, your Sun sign.
venus.howP2: This calculator uses precise astronomical ephemeris data to determine Venus's exact position at your time of birth. When birth time is provided, the calculation is accurate to the degree. Without birth time, Venus's sign is typically still correct since it moves relatively slowly through the zodiac.
venus.faq1a: Your Venus sign is the zodiac sign Venus was in at the moment of your birth. It governs your approach to love, beauty, pleasure, and attraction — revealing your romantic personality.
venus.faq2q: Is my Venus sign the same as my Sun sign?
venus.faq2a: Not necessarily. Venus can only be within two signs of your Sun sign, so it may be the same sign or one of the four adjacent signs. Many people have different Sun and Venus signs.
venus.faq3q: Do I need my exact birth time?
venus.faq3a: For Venus sign, exact birth time is usually not critical since Venus moves slowly (3-4 weeks per sign). However, for the exact degree, birth time improves accuracy.
venus.faq4q: What if Venus was retrograde when I was born?
venus.faq4a: Venus retrograde in a birth chart can indicate a more internalized or unconventional approach to love. You may be more reflective about relationships and take longer to express your feelings openly.

moonCompat.title: Moon Sign Compatibility
moonCompat.subtitle: Emotional Connection
moonCompat.description: Your Moon signs reveal your deepest emotional needs. Compare Moon placements to understand your emotional compatibility and nurturing styles.
moonCompat.intro: While Sun signs describe your outward personality, Moon signs govern your inner emotional world. Moon sign compatibility reveals how two people connect at the deepest emotional level — how they nurture each other, process feelings, and create emotional safety in a relationship.
moonCompat.uncertainMsg: Moon may have been in a different sign on this date. The Moon moves quickly through the zodiac (~12–14° per day). Providing exact birth times gives a definitive result.
moonCompat.shareText: Moon in {signA} & Moon in {signB} — {score}% emotional compatibility!
moonCompat.faq1q: Why is Moon sign compatibility important?
moonCompat.faq1a: The Moon governs your emotional needs, instincts, and how you feel safe. When two people's Moon signs are compatible, they naturally understand each other's emotional language and can provide the comfort each person needs.
moonCompat.faq2q: Do I need an exact birth time for my Moon sign?
moonCompat.faq2a: The Moon changes signs every 2–2.5 days. If you were born on a day when the Moon changed signs, your exact birth time determines which Moon sign is correct. Without a birth time, there is some uncertainty, which we flag in results.
moonCompat.faq3q: Can two incompatible Moon signs still work?
moonCompat.faq3a: Yes. Awareness of different emotional needs is the first step to meeting them. Many couples with challenging Moon sign combinations thrive because they learn to communicate and respect each other's emotional styles.

marriage.title: Marriage Compatibility
marriage.subtitle: Long-term Partnership
marriage.description: Explore the astrological dynamics of a long-term partnership. This tool compares natal charts to reveal emotional, romantic, and commitment-related compatibility themes.
marriage.intro: Marriage compatibility in astrology examines how two charts interact across the dimensions most relevant to long-term partnership: emotional bonding, communication harmony, romantic attraction, shared values, and commitment potential. No astrological score can predict marriage success — but understanding your dynamics can support better communication and self-awareness. This page is a tropical Western reading. For Ashtakoota, Mangal dosha, and porutham, use the
marriage.howP1: This compatibility analysis compares the actual planetary positions in both birth charts using precise ephemeris calculations. It evaluates major aspects between all ten planets, from the Sun through Pluto. Houses, when a city and time are given, are whole sign.
marriage.howP2: Scores are weighted by relevance: Venus-Mars aspects influence romance scores, Moon contacts affect emotional scores, Mercury aspects shape communication scores, and Sun-Saturn contacts inform long-term indicators.
marriage.faq1q: Can astrology predict if a marriage will work?
marriage.faq1a: No. Astrology can illuminate the dynamics, strengths, and growth areas of a partnership, but no chart comparison can predict the success or failure of a marriage. Human choices, communication, and effort are always the determining factors.
marriage.faq2q: What's the difference between this and Sun sign compatibility?
marriage.faq2a: Sun sign compatibility compares only one placement. This tool compares the actual positions of Sun, Moon, Mercury, Venus, and Mars in both charts, analyzing the specific aspects (angles) between them for a much more detailed picture.
marriage.faq3q: Is this Vedic (Guna Milan) or Western astrology?
marriage.faq3a: This tool uses Western tropical astrology. Vedic astrology's Guna Milan system uses a different zodiac and scoring methodology. Both traditions offer valid perspectives but should not be mixed in a single analysis.
marriage.faq4q: Do I need exact birth times?
marriage.faq4a: Birth times improve accuracy, especially for Moon sign (which moves quickly). Without times, Moon placement may be approximate. All other planet positions remain accurate for date-based calculation.

soulmate.faq2a: Venus (love style and attraction), Moon (emotional needs), Mars (passion and desire), and the 7th house ruler (partnerships) are the most significant placements for understanding your romantic nature.

synastry.whatIsP1: A synastry chart compares two natal charts planet by planet. The angles between your planets and theirs — called aspects — show where the connection flows naturally and where it creates friction. Sun-sign compatibility compares one point in each chart. A synastry chart compares every planet with every planet, which is why two people with "incompatible" Sun signs can still have a strong connection.
synastry.howToReadTitle: How to read your synastry chart
synastry.howToRead1: Start with the tightest aspects — the smaller the orb, the stronger the contact. Anything under 2° is felt strongly by both people.
synastry.howToRead2: Look at Venus and Mars contacts first — these describe attraction and chemistry. Venus-Mars aspects between two charts are the classic indicator of romantic spark.
synastry.howToRead3: Check Moon contacts — Moon-to-Moon and Moon-to-Sun aspects reveal whether you feel emotionally safe and understood with each other.
synastry.howToRead4: Note Saturn aspects — Saturn brings commitment but also friction. A Saturn trine to Venus is long-lasting love; a Saturn square can feel limiting.
synastry.howToRead5: Count harmonious vs tense — a healthy relationship chart usually has both. Trines and sextiles provide ease; squares and oppositions create growth.
synastry.faq1q: Do I need an exact birth time for a synastry chart?
synastry.faq1a: Planet-to-planet aspects work without a birth time. House overlays, the Rising sign, and the exact Moon position need a known time. Without a time, positions are calculated at noon and the Moon is marked as approximate.
synastry.faq2q: How is synastry different from a composite chart?
synastry.faq2a: Synastry compares the two charts directly — planet to planet. A composite chart blends them into one midpoint chart for the relationship. Synastry shows how you interact; a composite shows what the relationship itself is like.
synastry.faq3q: What are the most important synastry aspects?
synastry.faq3a: Venus-Mars cross-aspects (romantic attraction), Moon-Moon and Sun-Moon (emotional bond), and Saturn contacts (long-term staying power) are what most astrologers look at first.
synastry.faq4q: Is this synastry chart calculator free?
synastry.faq4a: Yes. The full synastry chart, aspects, house overlays, and compatibility themes are free. No signup, no account, no payment required.
synastry.faq5q: Can I use this for friendships or family?
synastry.faq5a: Absolutely. Synastry works for any two people. The same aspects that show romantic chemistry also reveal communication patterns, friction points, and areas of natural support in any relationship.
